label: Why Don't They Just
line: Name the obvious fix the viewer would suggest, then the rule of the system that blocks it, the exception that proves the rule, and what the rule means.
best_for: a design decision that looks stupid from outside
a question fans or newcomers keep asking about a story, a period of history or a system
also_for: a tool did something that looks wrong, when the cause is a rule and not a bug
avoid_for: a question the audience has seen answered many times
a rule that is a guess: the rule needs a source

beats.name: The obvious fix
beats.job: The question as the viewer would ask it: why not just do the obvious thing?

beats.name: Catch-up and irony
beats.job: One clause on who or what this is, for a newcomer, plus an irony that sharpens the question.

beats.name: The rule
beats.job: The rule that blocks the fix, with its source and one concrete picture of it at work.

beats.name: Proof by exception
beats.job: Who or what managed it anyway, and what made that case different.

beats.name: The rule as meaning
beats.job: What the rule says about the system, or one dry line that answers the first question again.

hooks.shape: [Something odd in the design or on the map]. By every obvious rule it should have [changed long ago].
[Obvious fix] would end [problem] overnight. Nobody does it.

holds: One question that gets sharper each time and is never merely repeated. A short answer may come at once if it stays incomplete. The re-ask and the exception re-open it; refusing the next obvious step ('surely then...? No.') is a third.
ending: The rule restated as meaning, or a dry one-sentence kicker with the present-day state.
pitfalls: An open debate with no verdict
An obscure detail as the subject: the obscure detail has to be the answer
A question opening under a publish title that asks the same question: title the video with the rule or the exception, and let the opening ask
template: Why don't [they] just [obvious fix]? [Subject] is [one-clause identity], and yet [irony]. So why not? Because [rule], as [source] shows. In practice, [one concrete picture of the rule at work]. Only [named exception] manages it, because [what is different]. For everyone else, [the rule restated as meaning].
